about: Free daily and monthly limits for each provider and model. Each entry names the official page where the limit was read, and the day it was read. A limit that the docs do not state is null with the confidence unknown. Nobody guesses a limit. A model entry is an exact model id, a pattern that starts with * (a suffix match), or * for every other model. The scope says what one count covers: a model, or the whole provider account.

resetRules.utc-midnight: The day limit resets at 00:00 UTC. This is the default when a provider's docs say nothing.
resetRules.pacific-midnight: The day limit resets at midnight Pacific time, and the clock follows daylight saving time.

groq.resetNote: The Groq docs do not state a reset time, so UTC midnight applies.

*.note: The page shows the Developer plan table only. It gives no free plan numbers. The response header x-ratelimit-remaining-requests counts requests left in the day (RPD), so Runner can observe the daily limit from it.

gemini.resetNote: The docs say that the daily requests quota resets at midnight Pacific time.

*.note: The page sends the reader to Google AI Studio for the numbers of the project. It does not list the free tier numbers.

openrouter.resetNote: The docs count the daily requests in the current UTC day. They do not state the reset time in words.

*:free.note: Free model variants (ids that end in :free): 20 requests a minute, and 50 requests a day for an account that bought fewer than 10 credits. An account that bought 10 credits or more gets 1000 requests a day. All free models share one daily count. Runner has bought no credits.

*.note: A model that is not a :free variant is paid. The docs state no free limit for it.

together.resetNote: The docs state no reset time, so UTC midnight applies.

*.note: The page gives no limit for a free account or a free model. It does not mention a free tier.

huggingface.resetNote: The docs state no reset time for requests. Credits of a paid plan renew each month.

*.note: The pricing page says that free users get no monthly credits for Inference Providers. A free user must buy credits, or move to PRO. The page states no request limit.

opencode.resetNote: The docs state no reset time, so UTC midnight applies.

*.note: The page lists models that cost nothing, and says that several are free for a limited time. It states no request limit for them.

omniroute.resetNote: OmniRoute is a gateway that Runner starts itself. The limit is the limit of the provider behind it.

*.note: A gateway adds no limit of its own. The limit comes from the upstream provider, which varies by route.

hermes.resetNote: A Hermes instance is a server that the owner runs. It has no provider quota.

*.note: A self-hosted instance. Its capacity is the capacity of its host and of the model that it calls.

custom.resetNote: A custom slot points at a provider that the owner chose. Runner knows no limit for it.

*.note: An OpenAI compatible endpoint of the owner's choice. The limit depends on that provider.
